name: No play
description: Woman aiming at camera, mock-serious 'don't play with me' meme. Comic toughness, not a real threat.
whenToUse: Playful only: someone is joking too much, testing the bot, 'don't play', 'I no dey play', 'be serious now', or you are mock-warning them to focus. Banter between friends. Always keep the reply light so it reads as a joke.
whenNotToUse: Never for real anger, threats, fights, crime, weapons talk, or scary situations. Skip kids-in-distress, sad news, and anything that could look like violence. If unsure, do not send.
